groups.label: Guerrilla Warfare
groups.gate: National military lessons. Southern revolutionary support is an optional communist policy; internal security requires actual control and unrest.

groups.label: Cambodia
groups.gate: Cambodia exists. War, intervention and occupation stages require their real campaign conditions.
groups.note: Cambodia is CBD. The border option can remain limited. Capital capture does not finish the guerrilla war or award annexation.

groups.label: China
groups.gate: China exists. China begins as a possible aid patron; combat stages require an actual war.
groups.note: Preserve cooperation or prepare deterrence. A limited counterstroke is an alternative war plan, not a promise to conquer China.

nodes.label: The Long War

nodes.availability_code: Existing army institutions. No specific party or current war required.

decisions.label: A doctrine review

decisions.result: A single funded military exercise using existing doctrine/training systems.
decisions.cost_risk: Not a technology grant or automatic switch to guerrilla doctrine.

nodes.label: Political Liaison

nodes.conditions: Domestic liaison is general. Southern party support additionally requires the actual communist governing subparty and a valid native target.
nodes.availability_code: Domestic liaison is general. Southern party support additionally requires the actual communist governing subparty and a valid native target.

decisions.label: Southern political liaison

decisions.result: Use the existing native foreign party support campaign.
decisions.cost_risk: Native support costs and cooldown; political support does not deliver weapons.

nodes.label: Small Unit Schools

nodes.conditions: Native doctrine and training systems remain authoritative.
nodes.availability_code: Native doctrine and training systems remain authoritative.

nodes.availability_code: Replaces Small Unit Schools.

nodes.availability_code: Dispersed Warfare. Continues only during an actual war.

nodes.description: A Cambodian commitment and a Chinese war cannot be funded as unrelated free bonuses. Define which obligation receives priority.

nodes.label: Sustain Mobilisation

nodes.conditions: Exclusive strategic exit. Actual ongoing war or verified continuing confrontation.
nodes.availability_code: Exclusive strategic exit. Actual ongoing war or verified continuing confrontation.

nodes.label: A Diplomatic Opening

nodes.conditions: Exclusive strategic exit. China may refuse. Preparedness decisions remain available while talks proceed.
nodes.reward_summary: Propose a frontier stand down; Opening Talks
nodes.availability_code: Exclusive strategic exit. China may refuse. Preparedness decisions remain available while talks proceed.

decisions.label: Propose a frontier stand down

decisions.result: A recipient owned offer starts verification if accepted.
decisions.cost_risk: No automatic normalization, recognition or peace.

nodes.label: The Long Frontier
nodes.description: Prepare the army for persistent fighting and recurring strain. A larger military commitment still has to be paid for.
nodes.conditions: Sustain Mobilisation. Replaces Prolonged Mobilisation; expires or cancels when the confrontation actually ends.
nodes.availability_code: Sustain Mobilisation. Replaces Prolonged Mobilisation; expires or cancels when the confrontation actually ends.

nodes.label: Verify the Stand down

nodes.availability_code: A Diplomatic Opening and actual Chinese acceptance. Burdens are not removed on a merely sent proposal.

decisions.label: Verify frontier measures
decisions.conditions: Accepted current proposal and actual reciprocal measures.
decisions.result: Reduce the exceptional confrontation burden only after execution checks.
decisions.cost_risk: Stale acceptance cannot debit or reward a different proposal.

nodes.label: Rebuild the North
nodes.description: Repair real damaged buildings and restore civilian life. Reconstruction requires funding and normal native construction capacity.
nodes.conditions: Owned and controlled damaged northern states; fighting sufficiently reduced. Country repair bonus is national, not geographically exclusive.
nodes.reward_summary: Northern Reconstruction; Fund native reconstruction projects
nodes.availability_code: Owned and controlled damaged northern states; fighting sufficiently reduced. Country repair bonus is national, not geographically exclusive.

decisions.label: Native northern reconstruction
decisions.conditions: Owned and controlled northern states and available native capacity.
decisions.result: Use native state investment and ordinary construction to repair and rebuild.
decisions.cost_risk: Native cash and civilian construction requirements apply.

nodes.label: A Sustainable Frontier
nodes.description: Preserve the military lesson and a viable relationship with the neighbour. An armed frontier and negotiated coexistence remain different outcomes.
nodes.conditions: An actual sustained or negotiated outcome. No automatic recognition, annexation or permanent attack bonus.
nodes.availability_code: An actual sustained or negotiated outcome. No automatic recognition, annexation or permanent attack bonus.

burdens.label: Two Front Commitments
burdens.when: Actual war with CHI and either actual war with CBD or a verified continuing Cambodian intervention.
burdens.ends: Recompute when a real war or verified commitment ends. A sent withdrawal offer does not count.

burdens.label: The Cambodian Commitment
burdens.when: Actual occupied Cambodian non core states or a lawfully recorded continuing military support mission.
burdens.ends: Verified partner readiness reduces this to 2% supply consumption and 2% bureaucracy expenses. Verified drawdown ends it. A sent proposal or capital capture does neither.

burdens.label: A Prolonged Frontier
burdens.when: Real prolonged Chinese frontier war or an agreed continuing emergency state after the main assault.
burdens.ends: Actual peace/verified stand down; cannot be an arbitrary permanent penalty.

burdens.label: An Unsettled Peace
burdens.when: A relevant postwar grievance event in actually governed territory. Highland armed resistance is conditional.
burdens.ends: An earned funded domestic settlement or a reviewed security outcome, not an instant universal surrender.

burdens.label: A Threatened Southwest
burdens.when: Actual grave Cambodian border hostility and affected Vietnamese controlled southern provinces. This is not a starting hostility in the opening scenario.
burdens.ends: A genuine military settlement that defeats the threat, or a verified limited agreement for its actual term. A limited agreement gives no secured partner victory dividend.

sources.label: Cambodian resistance and a political process

rules: Concept only. No loaded mod files changed.
Native keys are verified, proposed values and event combinations still require implementation and engine tests.
Every timed policy replaces its current family. Renewals require payment and live eligibility. The secured southwest dividend is conditional on a real victory and continuing friendly border security.
Opponent bonuses apply against that country across all fronts. National costs affect Vietnam as a whole.
Occupation resistance/compliance applies only to actual non core occupation. It does not create NLF or FULRO units.
Offers require the intended current recipient, funds, live conditions, acceptance and cleanup. No forced peace or automatic annexation.
Future governments and conflicts are conditional; no historical war is forced by a calendar date.
Productivity growth factors scale the actual signed growth calculation. They are not instant GDP changes or an unconditional penalty/benefit in every economic state.
